Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

Born of brutal @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} blood-magic experiments in Old World castles and chantries, the Blood Brothers are not truly a clan but an artificial bloodline of soldiers and servants. Linked by a literal hive-mind shared among the members of a 'circle,' they coordinate seamlessly even across distance, making them ideal for security, sabotage, and synchronized assaults. Despite the name, unconfirmed rumors persist of female members.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Potence, Sanguinus

Advantage: Chosen for their hardiness and bound into a circle, Blood Brothers gain an extra Physical Trait at creation and share the Discipline of Sanguinus.

Disadvantage: Blood Brothers are barely individuals; created in packs and stripped of independent will, they are sluggish to act on their own and suffer without the circle of siblings they are bound to.

Organization: Blood Brothers operate exclusively in tight-knit circles bound by their shared mind, rarely if ever acting outside the unit that was created with them.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{the Sabbat} - the antitribu designation itself marks this bloodline's members as having sided with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} rather than the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}.
